remaining_gaps: Public Land Order 326 of August 30, 1946 (11 FR 10298), which the Federal Register catalogue records as revoking this order in part, is held only as a catalogue note; its text and the lands it released are not held, so the clause's state on 2026-10-14 cannot be decided.

Proclamation 2965 of February 25, 1952 (recorded as revoking this order in part), Public Law 98-63 of July 30, 1983 (97 Stat. 323) and Public Land Order 6458 of August 25, 1983 (48 FR 40232) (recorded as amending it), and Public Land Order 1707 of August 6, 1958 (23 FR 6182) are held only as catalogue notes; their texts and the lands affected are not held (a 2003 index mentions an extension of PLO 6458 without text), so the state of the reservation on 2026-10-14 cannot be decided.

Pub. L. 97-113 (95 Stat. 1540, 22 U.S.C. 2501-1), which the 1989 codification's editorial note says made the Peace Corps an independent agency and so changed section 1-101 ('an agency within ACTION'), is not held as statute text; the statute that later ended ACTION (the 1993 national service legislation) is likewise not held, so the state of the ACTION-dependent clauses (1-101, 1-112, 1-5, 1-6, 1-602 to 1-605, 1-703) on 2026-10-14 cannot be decided. The dossier inventory (nine clauses, with duplicates, covering about a fifth of the order) also needs a full override before any claim.
